## Overview

This ongoing project focuses on building a computational framework to optimize the production of bioplastic (PHA) in *Pseudomonas putida* using deep learning and metabolic control analysis.

## Key Contributions

- Building a computational framework to optimize the **production of bioplastic (PHA)** in *Pseudomonas putida*.
- Developing **metabolic sub-network reconstruction** for enhancing PHA production pathways.
- Formulating a **dynamic simulations and MCA** based framework to analyze metabolic engineering targets.
